source_adjustments: Old Unit return spelling changed to official ().

Side-effecting mark and mutate_input remain ordinary C externals without a pure use {} declaration. Each original call is routed through a test-owned HostProbe effect/handler and local with; host symbols, C bodies, evaluation trace and input mutation remain unchanged.

counter wraps its escaped reader invocations in State.run(0, ...); owned and bytes wrap the original short-circuit comparison/reader expression in State.run with a concrete empty String/Bytes initial value. This discharges the public effect boundary without changing captured original State cells. Original named-argument order test, failure case and nested State bodies are unchanged.

The shared test-only legacy helper parses old @export(c,...) annotations into configuration and removes the annotations before official compilation. It changes only import Std.Bytes to import Emelino.Bytes for the ordinary validated extension.
observations: counter returns 83 through an escaped captured State reader.
String state snapshots preserve a\0b while host mutate_input overwrites the borrowed source buffer with zzz.
Failure payloads and nested State runs retain the original results and release all allocations.
Named argument evaluation keeps state_order()==42 and host trace==132.
Bytes state saved/final/read values retain a\0b / a\0b! after host mutation.
A returned Bytes-capturing closure keeps its owner after the host input is overwritten; shared_bytes doubles captured bytes and remains valid after the caller releases the original.
The exact original C harness checks heap emptiness over 1000 iterations at each C optimization level.
